@keyboard.description: The Keyboard menu, the keyboard chooser, and a keyboard with no name.

@reload.description: The command that reads the keyboard again.

@refresh.description: The button shown when no keyboard is connected.

@language.description: The menu that chooses the language the app shows.

@languageSystem.description: The language menu item that follows the languages the user prefers.

@lockUnlock.description: The command that starts unlocking a locked keyboard.

@lockLock.description: The command that locks an unlocked keyboard.

@lockUnlocking.description: The command label while the unlock keys are held.

@statusBusy.description: The spinner in the title bar while the app talks to a connected keyboard.

@toolbarLabel.description: The accessible name of the title bar.

@emptyTitle.description: The empty state when no keyboard is connected.

@loading.description: Shown while a keyboard is being looked for and read.

@unlockHold.description: The instruction during the unlock countdown.

@unlockKeys.description: Shown during unlock when the keyboard did not name the keys to hold.

@unlockProgress.description: The accessible name of the unlock progress bar.

unlockRemain: {count, plural, one {# left. Unplug and plug in to stop.} other {# left. Unplug and plug in to stop.}}

@unlockRemain.description: How many unlock steps remain, and how to cancel.

@holdAnd.description: Placed between the names of the keys to hold for unlock.

@layoutOption.description: A layout option the keyboard did not name.

@boardLabel.description: The accessible name of the drawn keyboard.

@keyFallback.description: A chosen key with no name, in the context menu.

@panelLabel.description: The accessible name of the pane that assigns the chosen key.

@hintChooseKey.description: The assignment pane when no key is selected.

notInMatrix: This key is not in the matrix

@notInMatrix.description: The assignment pane for a key the keymap cannot set.

@slotTap.description: The slot for what a key does when tapped.

@slotHold.description: The slot for what a key does while held.

@slotsLabel.description: The accessible name of the tap and hold slots.

@none.description: A tap or a hold with no key assigned.

@layerN.description: A layer named by its number, as a hold or in the key summary.

@rightPrefix.description: The prefix before the symbol of a right-side modifier, as R⌘.

@groupLayer.description: The heading of the layer choices for a hold, and the accessible name of the layer switch.

@groupModifiers.description: The heading of the modifier choices for a hold.

noteHoldBasicOnly: Only basic keys can be registered

@noteHoldBasicOnly.description: Why a hold cannot be combined with the chosen tap, and the error when that write is refused.

@turnCounterclockwise.description: The direction of a knob turned counterclockwise.

@turnClockwise.description: The direction of a knob turned clockwise.

@encoderSummary.description: The selected knob: its number, the way it turns, and the keycode in hexadecimal.

@keySummary.description: The selected key: its layer, its matrix position, and the keycode in hexadecimal.

@lockNote.description: Why the assignment pane offers no keys.

@kindOther.description: The page and the heading of keys that are not on the basic board.

@kindLayer.description: The page of keys that change the layer.

@kindMacro.description: The page and the heading of the keyboard's macro keys.

@kindCustom.description: The page and the heading of the keyboard's own keys.

@keyKind.description: The accessible name of the control that switches which keys are offered.

noteHoldLimitsTap: Only basic keys can be chosen

@noteHoldLimitsTap.description: Shown on the other key pages while the chosen key has a hold.

@editMacros.description: Opens the macro editor from the window toolbar, the macro page, and the Keyboard menu.

macroAssignHint: Choosing one assigns it to the key

@macroAssignHint.description: Shown on the macro page, beside the button that edits what a macro does.

@macroStepCount.description: How many steps the macro being edited has, when it has more than one.

@macroClose.description: Leaves the macro editor and returns to the key layout.

@macroAdd.description: The menu of steps that can be added to a macro.

@macroSave.description: Writes the macros back to the keyboard.

@macroEmpty.description: Shown when the chosen macro has no steps.

@macroTap.description: Adds a key the macro taps.

@macroDown.description: Adds a key the macro holds down.

macroDownNote: Holds the key down and continues

@macroDownNote.description: Shown while a press step is chosen. It stays down through later steps.

@macroUp.description: Adds a key the macro releases.

@macroUpNote.description: Shown while a release step is chosen.

@macroWait.description: Adds a wait to a macro.

@macroSteps.description: The accessible name of the chosen macro's steps.

@macroCharacters.description: The field for the characters a macro step types.

@macroMilliseconds.description: The field for how long a macro step waits.

@macroKey.description: The field for the key a macro step presses.

@macroBlank.description: A macro step that types nothing.

@stepPress.description: A macro step that holds keys down.

@stepRelease.description: A macro step that releases keys.

errMacroText: Only characters the keyboard can send

@errMacroText.description: Shown when macro text is empty or is not one byte per character.

@errMacroDelay.description: Shown when a wait does not fit the keyboard's macro format.

@errMacroWide.description: Shown when a key does not fit the keyboard's macro format.

errMacroFit: Does not fit ({need} bytes, the keyboard has {have})

@errMacroFit.description: Shown when the macros are larger than the keyboard's buffer.

@flashMacro.description: The notice after the macros are written.

@basicKeys.description: The accessible name of the basic key board.

@layerToggle.description: The heading for keys that toggle a layer.

@layerTo.description: The heading for keys that move to a layer.

@layerTapToggle.description: The heading for keys that toggle a layer when tapped.

@layerOneShot.description: The heading for keys that turn a layer on for one key.

@layerDefault.description: The heading for keys that set the default layer.

@groupJapanese.description: The heading for the Japanese keys.

@groupMedia.description: The heading for the media keys.

@groupMouse.description: The heading for the mouse buttons.

@groupWheel.description: The heading for the scroll wheel.

@whileHeld.description: Under a keycap whose only action is what it does while held.

@flashLocked.description: The notice after the keyboard locks.

@flashUnlocked.description: The notice after the keyboard unlocks.

@errLockFailed.description: Shown when the keyboard stays unlocked after a lock command.

@errKept.description: Shown when a write is refused and the keyboard keeps its key.

@errNoAnswer.description: Shown when the keyboard does not answer.

@errDisconnected.description: Shown when the keyboard is gone or the connection is closed.

errOutside: Cannot write to this key position

@errOutside.description: Shown when the position is outside the keymap.

errWrite: Failed to send to the keyboard

@errWrite.description: Shown when a report fails to send.

@errLockedAssign.description: Shown when an assignment is attempted while the keyboard is locked.

@deviceDuplicate.description: A keyboard's name when another connected keyboard has the same one.
